candidate.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
candidate.summary: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.

editorial.why_saudi: Wildlife discoveries capture everyday curiosity about nature and animal behavior. Saudis connect with stories about the natural world and conservation.
editorial.why_now: Published today at 23:15 UTC. Fresh discovery with visual appeal and genuine novelty—a new species identified after being confused with relatives.
editorial.angle: A spotted wildcat in Bolivia was mistaken for a cousin for years until researchers realized it's actually a completely different species. Only one known member exists. Natural history mystery solved.
editorial.share_reason: Unusual animal facts with a distinctive detail (only one living member known) create shareable interest without requiring expertise. Visually interesting for Snapchat.
